title: 風塵みたいなあたしでも

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Derby… The Derby? The Derby, huh? Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After attaining her major goal of entering the Classics, Mejiro Ryan is somewhat lacking in concentration. It's called "burnout syndrome."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her roommate, meanwhile…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The Derby! The Derby! Woohoo, I'm gonna be in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin seems to be even more enthusiastic about her training than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an attempt to get Ryan back on track, I get her to talk with Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Ryan and her trainer! How do ya do-do? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines… You've been running with so much energy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Taking the lead at Tokyo Racecourse isn't gonna be an easy task.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I definitely want to do well in this race now that all these miracles are finally lining up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All these… miracles?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep! To begin with, it's already a miracle that I was able to come to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Mom, I'm heading off for my first day at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Okay. Be careful out there!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Don't you worry about us here. Just give your best effort at everything you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right… Are you sure you'll be okay without me? I know how tight things are here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And someone has to look after my little sisters…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's very thoughtful of you. But I'm gonna tell you something.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: This can't be all there is to your life, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I just enjoy running, you know? It's not like I have a promising future ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's reason enough for you to go.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter whether you succeed or not. I want you to do what you want to do, even if it doesn't last forever.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've got no natural talent, no famous lineage, no freedom—just a whole buncha no's!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But somehow, of all people, I get to race in the Derby with this select few?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I did the best I could with what little skills I had, came to Tracen Academy, and even claimed victory in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And somehow, everything at home has been fine! That's very important! It hasn't been that long, but even that's a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't excited. Everything's been a miracle… So I need to make it all count.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whatever happens to me afterward is fine. ♪ I'm gonna be just like you when you burned yourself out at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see… That's why you're working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan looks up at the sky, pondering something. And then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: In my case, I guess I had everything…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was called the hope of the Mejiros, so it was only natural that I'd go to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I had no confidence in myself, and I wasted everything that was given to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I finally woke up to that fact in the nick of time and barely made it. And now, I'm totally spent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm no good in the end, huh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I don't even deserve to line up at the starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Is that how you feel?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan, you wanna know what I think? I think that we're all similar in some ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We are?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep. Not realizing what's important, feeling anxious, losing focus…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Unlike the seniors, we're still so inexperienced. But you could say that means we have a lot of room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We've always been together, so I know how you shine brightest when things get tough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's not like I always gave it my all, every single time I've been out there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So… let's do this for real. With everything we have, and everything we're lacking—with all that we are.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And McQueen isn't around, so it's just the two of us. Let's leave it all out there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh… Yeah, let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run with all my strength! I'll make up for the time I've wasted!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And as your friend, I wanna show you what I'm capable of as a runner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A new flame is lit within Ryan's smoldering heart. It looks like the second round of the Classics will be an exciting matchup.
